sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. The pipeline stays exactly where it is — store (crates/store/src/embeddings.rs) owns the vector key, enrich (crates/daemon/src/enrich.rs) owns mint + text preparation, batch (crates/daemon/src/batch.rs) owns call planning, search read path owns dedupe. The plan changes each layer's CONTRACT minimally and freezes the seams before fan-out: (S1) VECTOR KEY becomes (source_hash, source_kind, chunk_no, model_key) with chunk_no smallint DEFAULT 0 — one migration, existing rows read back as chunk 0, no backfill. (S2) CHUNK PLAN is a pure function chunk_plan(text, window_tokens, overlap_tokens) -> Vec<ChunkText{chunk_no, text}> living in enrich; window sized just under the model cap (target ~7500 tokens estimated by the repo's bytes/3 convention), overlap ~200 tokens; single-chunk inputs return exactly one chunk_no=0 entry so the common path is unchanged. (S3) HYGIENE is two predicates: minted-side (a turn/element whose prepared text is empty-or-whitespace mints NO embed job — WARN once at mint naming the source) and assembly-side (batch planner drops any empty text it is handed with a WARN naming source_hash, and the call proceeds for the rest — defense in depth, mutation-checked separately). (S4, AMENDED 2026-08-30 per o-prime ruling on PM recon evidence) READ dedupe: NO element collapse exists today — the invariant held by accident of the 1-vector-per-(hash,kind) key (nearest CTE embeddings.rs:469-563 has no DISTINCT/GROUP BY; fuse merges lexical-vs-semantic only). u3 ADDS the collapse INSIDE the store's nearest CTE at the admission point: group by resolved element, keep best (lowest distance) chunk, and apply the caller's LIMIT to ELEMENTS, not vectors. Nothing moves to daemon fuse — lexical fusion (#74) untouched, reviewer drift check applies verbatim. Without this, chunking lets one whale element crowd every other element out of top-k (the population-created-by-a-sibling failure mode). Side-benefit: also closes the pre-existing raw+smart duplicate-hit defect (nearest constrains model_key but not source_kind) — named, not claimed as scope. Known constraint: the batch planner's token-budget splitting and retry-travels-alone semantics are FROZEN — chunks are just more inputs to the same planner. fs2 prior art (ChunkItem with chunk_index + line spans, content-type-aware sizes) is the reference, not the spec: v1 is one window size, spans deferred.

sections.name: fan_out
sections.value: Fan out: YES, three units, all starting concurrently against the frozen seams. [AMENDED 2026-08-30 per o-prime ruling on PM stop-and-ask #2: the original shared-worktree shape was impossible — one worktree has one HEAD — and contradicted AGENTS.md worktree-per-coder policy.] Each coder gets its OWN worktree: ../fs3-embed-split-u1/-u2/-u3 on branches u1-store/u2-enrich/u3-read cut from 009-embed-split; per-seat CARGO_TARGET_DIR falls out per-worktree. KNOWN TYPE-LEVEL DEPENDENCY (named, not discovered at hour three): u2's final NewEmbedding construction (enrich.rs:714-723) needs u1's chunk_no field (embeddings.rs:84-98) — u2/u3 do their independent bodies first (chunk_plan + hygiene predicates + tests; collapse SQL + fixtures), u1 lands first on 009-embed-split, then u2/u3 each merge origin/009-embed-split into their OWN branch and gate for real. Merge order to the plan branch stays u1 -> u2 -> u3, PM composes and re-gates after each.

value.title: store: chunked vector key + poison heal
value.surface: crates/store/migrations/00XX_embed_chunks.sql (next free ordinal — CHECK, lexical took 0018, claim-index 0019), crates/store/src/embeddings.rs, one heal statement path
value.contract: PK gains chunk_no smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; upsert/read APIs take/return chunk_no; existing rows are chunk 0 (schema test proves shape + grandfather read); heal: UPDATE existing failed embed jobs whose payload text is empty -> terminal state the boot sweep ignores, returning the count (receipt in tests via fixture rows).
value.done_when: schema-shape test + grandfather test + heal test green; store suite green; no daemon code touched.

value.title: enrich: hygiene at mint + chunk windowing at prepare
value.surface: crates/daemon/src/enrich.rs (mint sites + the cap-WARN prepare site), crates/daemon/src/batch.rs (assembly-side drop only)
value.contract: chunk_plan() pure function per S2 (unit-tested standalone: cap-1, cap, cap+1, 3x-cap, overlap continuity); prepare emits N inputs tagged chunk_no instead of truncating (the truncated=true write path dies); mint-side empty predicate per S3 (turn/element empty-or-whitespace -> no job + one WARN); assembly-side drop per S3 with batch survival proven (a planted empty input does not reject its batchmates).
value.done_when: chunk_plan unit tests + both hygiene mutation checks green (removing the mint filter fails one test; removing the assembly drop fails the other); daemon enrich suite green.

value.title: search read + end-to-end proof
value.surface: crates/store/src/embeddings.rs (the nearest CTE — the collapse is ADDED here per amended S4; crates/daemon/src/search.rs must show NO diff), integration fixtures
value.contract: ADD the element collapse inside the store's nearest CTE per amended S4 (group by resolved element, best chunk, LIMIT over elements); ac-0003 two-leg fixture — (a) one row per element best score, (b) whale crowd-out: N matching chunks of one element do not reduce the count of OTHER elements returned at LIMIT k — both legs fail with the collapse removed; the TAIL-retrieval anchor (ac-0002, mutation-checked against chunking-off); the live isolated-daemon conversation fixture (ac-0006: 25KB turn fully searchable, empty turn zero provider traffic, clean log).
value.done_when: ac-0002/0003/0006 fixtures green; full harness checks green on the composed plan branch.

sections.name: isolation
sections.value: Worktree-per-coder [amended with fan_out, 2026-08-30]: ../fs3-embed-split-u1/-u2/-u3, branches u1-store/u2-enrich/u3-read cut from 009-embed-split, each with its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR; the gate mints per-run test DBs (post-#70) with base FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL as server selector; NEVER prod :7373 — the ac-0006 live proof runs an isolated daemon on an ephemeral port + disposable DB, torn down after. Read-only dogfood search/ask against prod is allowed and encouraged.

sections.name: composition
sections.value: PM merges u1 -> u2 -> u3 onto 009-embed-split (serial, re-gating after each), runs the composed harness checks + the ac-0006 live fixture itself (composition is where emergent defects appear — tenet 15), then opens ONE PR from 009-embed-split into main. Migration ordinal collisions with concurrently-merging packets are the known hazard (claim-index had to renumber): check origin/main's migrations immediately before the PR and renumber if taken.

sections.name: review
sections.value: Cross-model reviewer (gpt-5.6-sol high) after composition per packet-reviewer: plan fidelity against ac-0001..0007, the two mutation checks actually mutate (open the diffs), the frozen seams held (no batch-planner or ranking-algorithm drift), and the heal is terminal (boot sweep proof read, not assumed). Read-only; verdict to PM; PM relays with the packet's own judgment attached.

sections.name: risks
value: Migration ordinal race with in-flight packets — check latest origin/main migrations at PR time; renumber cleanly (precedent: claim-index 0018->0019).

Token-estimate drift: window sizing uses bytes/3 estimation; a pathological input could still exceed the true tokenizer cap — keep the existing cap-WARN as the LAST-RESORT guard (it should now never fire in practice; its firing post-merge is a regression signal krill's monitor will catch).
Dedupe key semantics: embed job dedupe is per (identity, source) — chunking must not change JOB identity (chunks are inputs within one job, never N jobs), or the queue inflates.
The empty-hash e3b0c442 (sha256 of empty string) is shared by EVERY empty body — the mint filter must key on content emptiness, not on having seen the hash fail before.

u3 ADDS the element collapse inside the store's nearest CTE per amended S4 — there is no existing collapse to find (the old premise was disproven by PM recon); any diff in daemon search.rs/fuse is drift against lexical-channel (#74) behaviour and the reviewer checks for it explicitly.
